description: Eerste Helmersstraat 215 (1897): the four-storey sister of 217-229: 6 m red-brown brick, three equal axes of two-light windows with a transom under shallow segmental brick heads, white sills, a bellied iron balconette on the centre axis of storeys 1-3, one white vent panel per axis in the frieze under a cream moulded cornice at 14.3 m; a small dormer

door-left.note: double door under a fanlight on the left axis, two windows with a transom

rhythm.identicalBays: upper storeys: 3 two-light windows with a transom, one width
rhythm.symmetry: upper storeys symmetric; door on the left
rhythm.roofline: cream moulded cornice at 10.8 m over a frieze with three vent panels; one pointed timber dormer

match.note: Eerste Helmersstraat 215: four storeys, cornice 14.3 m on the strip

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2024-11-29 pand 3 (215) at 1.2x with a metre grid: storey-1 windows 4.3-6.3 m, storey-2 7.3-9.3, storey-3 10.4-12.2, balconettes at 4.0, 7.2 and 10.5 m on the centre axis, vents 13.2 m, cornice 13.5-14.3

schemaLimits: the 2x2 small-pane top light of storey 1 is drawn as the t-window's single top light (transom at 0.76 of the window; the photo transom is at 0.6-0.63)
the bellied (bombe) iron balconette is the library's straight projecting guard
the dormer's finial is not drawn
